LanguageData.MF_Bridge_LocalHint: Post the selected original or edit locally to the RimGram colony account. It will not be sent online. RimGram's posting interval and reactions apply. You can also make a sharing copy.
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_TalkHint: Only this button requests your configured RimTalk AI once. No image file is sent: the text below asks the selected person to recall it. AI usage may be charged. The album caption stays unchanged.
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_NoSpeaker: No available colonist is on the current map
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_NoRimGram: RimGram's public photo publishing feature is unavailable. Sharing copies and path copying are still available.
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_NoRimTalk: This RimTalk version has no supported public dialogue request feature.
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_Stale: The selected photo or game changed. Reopen it from the album.
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_Cooldown: RimGram posting is available in {0} game hours.
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_RequestOnce: Request this comment once through RimTalk
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_Exported: Sharing folder path copied. It contains photo.png, caption.txt, and manifest.json.
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_ExportFailed: Could not create the sharing copy. The original is unchanged.
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_TalkRejected: RimTalk could not accept this request. Check its settings, game speed, and active conversations. It will not retry automatically.
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_PostRejected: RimGram did not accept the post. Check its posting interval or the current game.
LanguageData.MF_Bridge_CallFailed: The connection failed. It was not retried, to prevent duplicates. Check the other mod to see whether it accepted the request.
